name: combat-round-waits-hits
description: Both sides roll a round before its hits are assigned (LRR 78.4/40; combat-ux): pbd60@151 on andeara muaat rolled round 2, mentak (round 1) owes its 1 hit: mentak rolls round 2 first (allowed: the side still to roll is never held back by that round's hits), then auto-assigns. Was: the roll refused, which made the hit side lose dice (pbd203 over-corrected).
